attributes.description:
Find a daily eating rhythm that fits your life.

Kvil follows your schedule automatically. A quiet timer shows when your next eating window opens. Need to eat earlier or begin your pause sooner? Adjust it from Home, with undo if you change your mind.

MAKE THE WEEK YOUR OWN
Guided setup helps you choose a rhythm and meal times. Set a separate eating window for each weekday, including overnight windows. Adjust today, take a day off, or plan a longer break.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Choose reminders for opening and closing, at the scheduled time or a little before. Reminders are scheduled about four weeks ahead and renewed when Kvil runs. Open the app occasionally to keep them going.

A SMALL SPACE TO REFLECT
An optional check-in lets you reflect on yesterday. A simple weekly recap brings your answers together without scores or streaks.

WEIGHT, IF YOU WANT IT
Log measurements and view a recent trend. Connect Apple Health to request permission to read weight and save new Kvil measurements in one step. You can turn off saving to Health in Settings. There are no required weight targets.

AT A GLANCE
Use Kvil on Apple Watch, your Home Screen, and your Lock Screen. The Watch keeps your latest schedule so its timer works when your phone is unavailable. Turn on Live Activities and open Kvil within eight hours of the next opening to see it on your Lock Screen. Siri and Shortcuts can tell you the next opening or open your plan.

QUIET BY DESIGN
Landscapes, warm ivory days, and deep green nights. All artwork and device integrations are included for free.

YOUR DATA
No Kvil account. Your schedule, days off, and fasting adjustments can sync in encrypted form through your private iCloud database. Reflections stay on your device with free backup export and restore. Weight shared with Apple Health follows your Health settings. No ads or third-party tracking.

ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
Your latest seven days of reflection history and a basic weekly recap are free. A single purchase unlocks older reflections and longer recaps. Your timer, schedules, reminders, artwork, weight logging, Apple Health, Watch, and widgets stay free.

Requires iOS 27 or later. Apple Watch requires watchOS 27 or later. Kvil is a planning tool for adults and does not provide medical advice.

Support: hjalmar@hkarlsen06.dev
attributes.promotionalText: A flexible daily eating schedule, gentle reminders, and space to reflect. Beautiful on iPhone, Apple Watch, and your widgets.
